nodes.name: Review accounting terminology
nodes.description: Spend 15 minutes reviewing key accounting terms and definitions.

nodes.name: Work through a practice problem
nodes.description: Solve one simple accounting problem (e.g., journal entry) daily.

nodes.name: Read a short accounting article
nodes.description: Read a brief article or blog post about an accounting topic.

nodes.name: Practice Excel formulas
nodes.description: Spend 20 minutes practicing a different Excel formula each day.

nodes.name: Work through a mini-spreadsheet
nodes.description: Create a small spreadsheet to solve a practical problem (e.g., budget tracker).

nodes.name: Learn a new Excel function
nodes.description: Research and attempt to use one new Excel function daily.

nodes.name: Complete one module
nodes.description: Dedicate 30-60 minutes to completing one module of the bootcamp.

nodes.name: Take a short quiz
nodes.description: Test your understanding of the material with a short quiz after each module.

nodes.name: Review key concepts
nodes.description: Spend 10 minutes reviewing the most important concepts from the module.

nodes.name: Analyze a sample financial statement
nodes.description: Choose a publicly traded company and analyze its income statement.

nodes.name: Read a financial statement analysis article
nodes.description: Read an article explaining how to interpret financial ratios.

nodes.name: Identify key trends
nodes.description: Look for trends in a financial statement and write down your observations.

nodes.name: Work through a Pandas tutorial
nodes.description: Spend 30 minutes working through a Pandas tutorial or example.

nodes.name: Clean a small dataset
nodes.description: Download a small dataset and practice cleaning it using Pandas.

nodes.name: Perform a simple analysis
nodes.description: Use Pandas to perform a simple analysis on the dataset (e.g., calculate summary statistics).

nodes.name: Read a tax law article
nodes.description: Read a short article about a specific tax law or regulation.

nodes.name: Review tax forms
nodes.description: Study a common tax form (e.g., 1040) and understand its sections.

nodes.name: Work through a tax calculation example
nodes.description: Solve a simple tax calculation problem.

nodes.name: Research common tasks
nodes.description: Spend 15 minutes researching the typical tasks of an entry-level accountant.

nodes.name: Review job descriptions
nodes.description: Read several entry-level accounting job descriptions to understand the requirements.

nodes.name: Practice interview questions
nodes.description: Practice answering common accounting interview questions.

nodes.name: Establish a regular sleep schedule
nodes.description: Go to bed and wake up at the same time each day, even on weekends.

nodes.name: Create a relaxing bedtime routine
nodes.description: Develop a calming routine before bed (e.g., reading, taking a bath).

nodes.name: Optimize your sleep environment
nodes.description: Ensure your bedroom is dark, quiet, and cool.

nodes.name: Increase run time by 5 minutes
nodes.description: Each run, aim to increase your run duration by 5 minutes.

nodes.name: Run at a consistent pace
nodes.description: Maintain a steady pace throughout your run.

nodes.name: Listen to your body
nodes.description: If you feel pain, slow down or stop.

nodes.name: Run 3 times this week
nodes.description: Commit to running at least three times this week.

nodes.name: Schedule runs in your calendar
nodes.description: Treat your runs like important appointments.

nodes.name: Find a running buddy
nodes.description: Running with a friend can help you stay motivated.

nodes.name: Warm-up for 5 minutes
nodes.description: Start with a 5-minute warm-up before interval training.

nodes.name: Alternate between high and low intensity
nodes.description: Alternate between periods of high-intensity running and recovery periods.

nodes.name: Cool-down for 5 minutes
nodes.description: End with a 5-minute cool-down after interval training.

nodes.name: Walk a hill for 30 minutes
nodes.description: Find a hill and walk up it for 30 minutes.

nodes.name: Increase the incline
nodes.description: Gradually increase the incline of the hill you're walking on.

nodes.name: Focus on posture
nodes.description: Maintain good posture while walking uphill.

nodes.name: Do 3 sets of 10 squats
nodes.description: Perform 3 sets of 10 bodyweight squats daily.

nodes.name: Focus on proper form
nodes.description: Maintain proper form throughout each squat.

nodes.name: Increase reps as you get stronger
nodes.description: Gradually increase the number of reps you perform.

nodes.name: Do 3 sets of as many pushups as possible
nodes.description: Perform 3 sets of pushups until you can't do another one.

nodes.name: Modify pushups if needed
nodes.description: If you can't do full pushups, modify them by doing them on your knees.

nodes.name: Increase sets or reps as you get stronger
nodes.description: Gradually increase the number of sets or reps you perform.

nodes.name: Hold a plank for 30 seconds
nodes.description: Hold a plank position for 30 seconds.

nodes.name: Increase hold time gradually
nodes.description: Gradually increase the amount of time you hold the plank.

nodes.name: Maintain proper form
nodes.description: Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.

nodes.name: Take 5 minutes to reflect
nodes.description: Set aside 5 minutes each day to reflect on your thoughts and feelings.

nodes.name: Journal about your emotions
nodes.description: Write down your emotions in a journal.

nodes.name: Identify triggers
nodes.description: Pay attention to what triggers your emotions.

nodes.name: Practice box breathing for 5 minutes
nodes.description: Follow the 4-4-4-4 breathing pattern (inhale for 4, hold for 4, exhale for 4, hold for 4).

nodes.name: Do box breathing when stressed
nodes.description: Use box breathing as a tool to manage stress.

nodes.name: Focus on your breath
nodes.description: Pay attention to the sensation of your breath.

nodes.name: Write down 3 things you're grateful for
nodes.description: Each day, write down three things you're grateful for.

nodes.name: Focus on the positive
nodes.description: Concentrate on the positive aspects of your life.

nodes.name: Review your gratitude list
nodes.description: Periodically review your gratitude list to reinforce positive feelings.

nodes.name: Identify negative thoughts
nodes.description: Become aware of negative thoughts and beliefs.

nodes.name: Challenge those thoughts
nodes.description: Question the validity of those thoughts.

nodes.name: Replace negative thoughts with positive ones
nodes.description: Reframe negative thoughts into more positive and realistic ones.

nodes.name: List your top 5 values
nodes.description: Identify your core values (e.g., honesty, kindness, creativity).

nodes.name: Reflect on how your actions align with your values
nodes.description: Assess whether your daily actions are consistent with your values.

nodes.name: Make adjustments as needed
nodes.description: Adjust your behavior to better align with your values.

nodes.name: Define a SMART goal
nodes.description: Set a goal that is Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound.

nodes.name: Break down your goal into smaller steps
nodes.description: Divide your goal into smaller, manageable steps.

nodes.name: Track your progress
nodes.description: Monitor your progress towards your goal.

nodes.name: Practice self-compassion
nodes.description: Treat yourself with kindness and understanding during difficult times.

nodes.name: Focus on what you can control
nodes.description: Concentrate on the aspects of a situation that you can influence.

nodes.name: Seek support from others
nodes.description: Reach out to friends, family, or a therapist for support.

nodes.name: Track anxiety levels
nodes.description: Keep a journal to track your anxiety levels throughout the day.

nodes.name: Identify anxiety triggers
nodes.description: Determine what situations or thoughts trigger your anxiety.

nodes.name: Practice relaxation techniques
nodes.description: Use relaxation techniques such as deep breathing or meditation.

nodes.name: Smile and make eye contact
nodes.description: Start with a simple smile and eye contact when interacting with others.

nodes.name: Ask open-ended questions
nodes.description: Ask questions that require more than a yes or no answer.

nodes.name: Initiate a conversation
nodes.description: Start a conversation with someone new each day.

nodes.name: Pay attention to the speaker
nodes.description: Focus entirely on the speaker and avoid interrupting.

nodes.name: Reflect back what you hear
nodes.description: Paraphrase or summarize what the speaker has said to ensure understanding.

nodes.name: Ask clarifying questions
nodes.description: Ask questions to gain a deeper understanding of the speaker's perspective.

nodes.name: Try to understand the other person's perspective
nodes.description: Put yourself in the other person's shoes and try to see things from their point of view.

nodes.name: Validate their feelings
nodes.description: Acknowledge and validate the other person's emotions (e.g., 'That sounds really frustrating').

nodes.name: Offer support
nodes.description: Let the other person know that you're there for them.

nodes.name: Observe without judgment
nodes.description: Describe the situation objectively without adding judgment or evaluation.

nodes.name: Express your feelings
nodes.description: Use 'I' statements to express your feelings (e.g., 'I feel frustrated when...').

nodes.name: Make a request
nodes.description: Clearly state what you want or need.

nodes.name: Find common ground
nodes.description: Look for shared interests or experiences with others.

nodes.name: Ask about their hobbies
nodes.description: Inquire about their hobbies and interests.

nodes.name: Share a relevant anecdote
nodes.description: Share a brief story or experience related to a shared interest.

nodes.name: Share a personal story
nodes.description: Share a small, relevant personal story to build trust.

nodes.name: Ask vulnerable questions
nodes.description: Ask questions that encourage the other person to share something personal (but be mindful of boundaries).

nodes.name: Listen without judgment
nodes.description: Offer a non-judgmental space for the other person to be vulnerable.

nodes.name: Understand your audience
nodes.description: Tailor your message to the specific audience you're addressing.

nodes.name: Use storytelling
nodes.description: Frame your message using stories and examples to make it more engaging.

nodes.name: Focus on benefits
nodes.description: Highlight the benefits of your message to the audience.
